description: osirAppList: List the authenticated user's deployed Osir apps with their live URLs and status. An entry with kind 'agent' is a ready-made AI agent (e.g. Hermes): manage it with the osirAgent* tools, never the osirApp* ones. Requires authentication.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: osirAppList
